rows.text: with `i` = `ecx`, an index above 0xB is replaced by 0 after a call `0016D6A0(0x200)` (made twice, once per use); takes the entry `e` = `02092760` + 8`i` and the counter cell `c` = qword `[020927C0]` + 4`i` + 0x47B8, and the word list `w` = `0020E600(dword [e+4])`; for each position `j` below dword `[c]` (signed) whose word `w[j]` is 0xFFFF, it re-decodes `w` and scans positions `j`+1 upward while below dword `[c]` for the first word that is not 0xFFFF: when one is found it moves it to `w[j]` and writes 0xFFFF in its place, and when none is found it stores `j` to dword `[c]` and returns; returns nothing
